thesis: This episode argues that successful capital allocation often involves evolving unique business models or acquiring assets quietly over long periods, particularly in difficult industries. It highlights specific examples like Constellation Software and Arch, while noting that the jury is still out on how major tech companies have handled buybacks versus R&D spending.
